question: What overcoming of death by aging results from abstaining from food by day?
premises: Non-eating by day is the stated means.
Death by aging is named as the object.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go beyond death by aging.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean overcome or pass beyond
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
